answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every identity to lock a non-poolable tenure stake that grows like velvet under sequential history-bound proofs. Each epoch the agent must submit a unique live measurement from a dedicated jetty-mounted sensor recording local juniper pollen density, binding the proof to that physical location and the identity's attested history. Splitting across clones multiplies required sensors and elapsed-time chains without sharing progress, so a farm pays linear hardware plus superlinear lost tenure opportunity.
